ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged widespread fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program that led to the Trump administration's halt on $259 million in payments.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to understand the flow of funds and identify potential entities involved in the alleged fraud.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud?
What actions are being taken to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue with Minnesota's Medicaid program and the Trump administration's response to it.
